evidence: Refactors block index writing, file flushes, and pruning deletion out of FlushStateToDisk in src/validation.cpp into src/node/blockstorage.cpp.
rationale: Decouples block storage internals from validation's flush logic to enable a standalone pruning API for libbitcoinkernel. As noted in the description, FlushStateToDisk's direct manipulation of prune locks, flags, and file deletions prevents clean extraction of block storage (#35627).
